                                                        Abstract
      Theorems 1 and 2 appearing in the paper contain a shared critical issue and this note serves as a
      retraction note. The issue is traced to the Theorem 4, which concerns the control of the Lipschitzness
      of a Gradient Descent (GD)-trained overparameterized shallow neural network in the input. In the
      following we describe the issue in some detail.

metric regression with random design where inputs X, X 1 , . . . , X n ∼ PX ∈ M1 (Sd−1 ) are i.i.d.
and targets are generated by the Lipschitz (possibly non-differentiable) and bounded regression
function f ⋆ on Sd−1 , as Yi = f ⋆ (X i ) + εi , with σ-subgaussian independent noise ε1 , . . . , εn . The
paper considers learning of f ⋆ by the shallow neural network predictor
